parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The disk category.

- cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk
- cloud_ssd: all-flash cloud disk
- local_hdd: local HDD
- local_ssd: local SSD

parameters.name: DiskChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing type.

- prepay: subscription
- postpay: pay-as-you-go

parameters.name: DiskId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud disk.

parameters.name: DiskType
parameters.description:
The disk purchase method.

- ServiceDisk: disk created by an edge service
- ResoureDisk: purchased with an instance
- PostPayDisk: purchased separately

parameters.name: EnsRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the ENS edge zone.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance to which the cloud disk is mounted.

parameters.name: OrderByParams
parameters.description: The sorting parameter. Format example: {"EnsRegionId":"desc"}. By default, results are sorted by edge zone ID in descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the query list. Minimum value: **1**.

Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **50**.

Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The disk status.

- In-use: in use
- Available: to be mounted
- Attaching: being mounted
- Detaching: being unmounted
- Creating: being created
- ReIniting: being reset
- Deleting: being released
- Deleted: released
- Expiring: about to expire

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The disk property.

- system: system cloud disk
- data: data cloud disk
